paite: Ka lei a thil ka hihkhelh louhna ding in ka omdante ka venghoih ding a; migilou-saloute ka ma a a-om sung uh ka kam mukgakna in ka gak ding, ka chi.
heading: David La / Gimthuakmi Kipuanna
english: For the Chief Musician. For Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”

paite: Huchi in dai dide in pau lou in ka om a, ahoih lam ah leng ka dai dide a; himahleh ka lungngaihna tohthoh in a-om zosop hi.
english: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.

paite: Ka sung ah ka lung asa vutvut a; ka ngaihtuah in mei akuangkhia a; ka lei in thu ka genta hi.
english: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:

paite: TOUPA, ka tawpna ding leh, ka dam chiang ding, bangchi ahi, chih, hon theisak inla; ka hinna beikindan hon theisak in.
english: “Yahweh, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.

paite: Ngai in, ka damsung khutpek tan phet in na siam a; ka kum na mitmuh in bangmah tham ahi kei a; michih ahoih lai pen un bangmah lou lel ahi vek uhi. Selah
english: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.

paite: Michih nuamsa bang in avak ngei ua; amawk buai ngei nak uhi. Gou akholkhawm ua, aluah ding lah athei kei uhi.
english: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.

paite: TOUPA aw, tu'n ah bang ka ngak dia? Nang ah ahi ka lametna a-om.
english: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.

paite: Ka tatlekna tengteng lak ah hon honkhia inla; mihai gensiat in hon omsak ke'n.
english: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.

paite: Nangmah hih ahih ziak in ka pau kei a, ka kam leng ka ka kei hi.
english: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.

paite: N'on satna ka kiang a kipan lasuan inla; na khut khak a hihman ka hi.
english: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

paite: Mi atatlekna ziak a thuhilh a na sawi in, adeih lai pen leikha bang in na hihsia a; michih bangmah lou lel ahi uhi. Selah
english: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.

paite: TOUPA aw, ka thumna ngaikhia inla, ka kikouna ah na bildoh inla; ka khitui kia daihsan ke'n; na mikhual ka hi a, ka pipute bang in Khualzin tam lel bang ka hi ngal a.
english: “Hear my prayer, Yahweh, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.

paite: Aw, hiai a kipan ka pawt a, ka om louh paisuak vengveng ma in, ka halh nawnna ding in hon hawi in.
english: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”
